subject: Matemática
description_pt: Calcular medidas de ângulos internos de polígonos regulares, sem o uso de fórmulas, e estabelecer relações entre ângulos internos e externos de polígonos, preferencialmente vinculadas à construção de mosaicos e de ladrilhamentos.

components.description_pt: Calcular medidas de ângulos internos de polígonos regulares sem usar fórmulas
components.description_en: Calculate interior angle measures of regular polygons without using formulas
components.cc_component_description: Prove the measures of interior angles of a triangle have a sum of 180º

components.description_pt: Estabelecer a relação entre ângulos internos e externos de um polígono
components.description_en: Establish the relationship between interior and exterior angles of a polygon
components.cc_component_description: Establish and use facts about the angle sum and exterior angles of triangles

components.description_pt: Aplicar relações de ângulos internos e externos para construir mosaicos ou tesselas
components.description_en: Apply interior and exterior angle relationships to construct mosaics or tessellations

cc_matches.description: Use informal arguments to establish facts about the angle sum and exterior angle of triangles, about the angles created when parallel lines are cut by a transversal, and the angle-angle criterion for similarity of triangles. *For example, arrange three copies of the same triangle so that the sum of the three angles appears to form a line, and give an argument in terms of transversals why this is so.*
